```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .ccl-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .ccl-header {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 30% 1fr;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .ccl-header-cell {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ccl-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 30% 1fr;
    align-items: stretch;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .ccl-row:hover {
    background: #F0EFF8;
  }

  .ccl-layer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    background: #EEEDF8;
  }

  .ccl-row:hover .ccl-layer {
    background: #E6E5F4;
  }

  .ccl-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  .ccl-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .ccl-name-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
  }

  .ccl-name {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .ccl-tree {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1px;
  }

  .ccl-tree-item {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #9B96D0;
    line-height: 1.4;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .ccl-flat {
    display: none;
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #9B96D0;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .ccl-resp {
    padding: 12px 20px;
    font-size: 0.95em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.5;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .ccl-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; justify-items: center; }
    .ccl-header-cell:last-child { display: none; }
    .ccl-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .ccl-layer { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; padding: 10px 14px; }
    .ccl-resp { padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.9em; }
    .ccl-tree { display: none; }
    .ccl-flat { display: block; }
  }
</style>

<div class="ccl-outer">
  <div class="ccl-header">
    <div class="ccl-header-cell">Component</div>
    <div class="ccl-header-cell">Responsibility</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ccl-row">
    <div class="ccl-layer">
      <div class="ccl-icon"><i data-lucide="file-text"></i></div>
      <div class="ccl-name-group">
        <div class="ccl-name">Context</div>
        <div class="ccl-tree">
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">├─ CLAUDE.md</div>
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">├─ rules</div>
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">└─ memory</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ccl-flat">— CLAUDE.md, rules, memory</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ccl-resp">Persistent knowledge and project conventions that survive across sessions</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ccl-row">
    <div class="ccl-layer">
      <div class="ccl-icon"><i data-lucide="wrench"></i></div>
      <div class="ccl-name-group">
        <div class="ccl-name">Capabilities</div>
        <div class="ccl-tree">
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">├─ tools</div>
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">├─ MCP</div>
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">└─ plugins</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ccl-flat">— tools, MCP, plugins</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ccl-resp">What Claude can act on: files, browsers, APIs, services, and custom integrations</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ccl-row">
    <div class="ccl-layer">
      <div class="ccl-icon"><i data-lucide="zap"></i></div>
      <div class="ccl-name-group">
        <div class="ccl-name">Behaviors</div>
        <div class="ccl-tree">
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">├─ skills</div>
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">└─ hooks</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ccl-flat">— skills, hooks</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ccl-resp">Skills define methodology on demand; Hooks enforce rules automatically, bypassing judgment</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ccl-row">
    <div class="ccl-layer">
      <div class="ccl-icon"><i data-lucide="cpu"></i></div>
      <div class="ccl-name-group">
        <div class="ccl-name">Agents</div>
        <div class="ccl-tree">
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">├─ subagents</div>
          <div class="ccl-tree-item">└─ verifiers</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ccl-flat">— subagents, verifiers</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ccl-resp">Delegated execution in isolated contexts, for parallelism, scope control, and auditable output</div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
